story: Round 1 of the 2026 Rolex Shanghai Masters concluded Wednesday at Qizhong Forest Sports City Arena. The top 32 seeds, who received opening-round byes, now prepare for their second-round entrances. Top seed Alexander Zverev headlines the top half of the draw, while newly crowned Tokyo champion Carlos Alcaraz and seven-time Beijing winner Novak Djokovic command the bottom half. With 1,000 ranking points on the line, the tournament kicks into high gear.
stakes: 1,000 ATP ranking points and a 1.1 million dollar winner check.
rivalryAngle: Alcaraz and Djokovic look to maintain Asian swing dominance.
